title_suffix: convergent task reviews and bounded repair loops
summary: OSpec 1.8.4 fixes Goal workflows that repeatedly alternated implementation and review work. Approved upstream reviews can remain valid only when every changed target is attributable to a completed transitive downstream task, and downstream review packets inherit explicit upstream regression obligations. Automatic task-review repair and grouped final-review repair are independently bounded to two rounds by default, while blocked final reviews stop for blocker resolution.
new: Added upstream regression obligations to downstream task-review packets whenever dependent tasks share target files.
Added independent Loop efficiency settings and CLI flags for task-review and grouped final-review repair, each defaulting to two automatic rounds.
Added durable retry trigger metadata so manual, worker-status, and task-review retries are counted independently.
improved: Task-review freshness now distinguishes unattributed file drift from changes owned by a completed transitive downstream task.
Repair-limit gates report exact task or final-wave counts and require explicit user authorization before the configured limit is raised.
fixed: Fixed dependent tasks with overlapping target files repeatedly invalidating already-approved upstream reviews and causing implementation/review ping-pong.
Fixed task-review and grouped final-review repair loops having no dedicated round guard when status fingerprints kept changing and reset the generic no-progress counter.
Fixed BLOCKED final reviews entering a grouped repair path that only accepts NEEDS_CHANGES and then throwing an execution error.
docs: Documented the 1.8.4 review carry-forward provenance rules, regression obligations, repair-round guard, and CLI configuration surface.
